item.title: 【Unreleased/Unofficial (lossy)】MP3 - Selena Gomez - BLISS (Deluxe Edition)
item.description:
This week, unreleased songs by "Selena Gomez" leaked, and it seems they are from the creative process of the never-released album "SG3".
So I made an album with all of them and some already released ones that would have been included on the album.


01 Love On
02 Choices
03 Try Your Luck
04 See U Never
05 Good Energy (Interlude)
06 Single Soon
07 Satisfied
08 Better Than
09 BLISS
10 In The Dark
11 Untraceable
12 LIGHT
13 I Feel Pretty (Bonus Track)
14 Daydreamin (Bonus Track)
15 No Credit (Bonus Track)
